title: Paella Pastry with Pomegranate Glaze
description: A sweet and savory pastry filled with the flavors of paella, topped with a tangy pomegranate glaze. Perfect as a brunch or dessert.
instructions: Roll out the pastry dough and place on a baking sheet.
Mix the oozy pomegranate jam and pomegranate molasses (if using).
Spread the jam mixture over the pastry dough, leaving a 1-inch border.
Top with the kissed almonds and paella rice.
Fold the edges of the pastry dough up over the filling.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Glaze with additional pomegranate jam (if desired).
